title: Peruvian Creamy Flatbread
description: A flavorful twist on traditional flatbread, infused with Peruvian spices and topped with a vibrant and sour cream sauce.
instructions: Arrange the flatbread pieces on a baking sheet.
Drizzle a small amount of oil over the flatbread.
Bake the flatbread for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the flatbread is baking, mix together the Peruvian yellow pepper, vibrant green chili, garlic, and chopped cilantro in a bowl.
Once the flatbread is done, remove it from the oven and top each piece with a spoonful of the pepper mixture.
Drizzle the sour cream over the top of the flatbread pieces.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
